title: Claude Code for Service Delivery: Learn from Boris Cherny, Head of Claude Code
description:
Join Boris Cherny, the inventor of Claude Code, for a session dedicated to professional services delivery teams.

See live demonstrations of Claude Code powering real modernization workflows - from COBOL-to-cloud migrations that compress months into weeks.

There’s also dedicated time for Q&A with Boris so you can hear the latest from the founder of Claude Code.
